title: Secondary Panel
purpose: Collapsible right sidebar with worktree (source control) and GitHub views
states: collapsed - panel closed showing only edge handle
open-worktree - panel open on worktree view
open-github - panel open on GitHub view
maximized - panel taking full width with panes minimized
acceptance: shall display worktree tab showing git status by default
shall display GitHub tab for viewing issues and PRs
shall support dragging divider to change panel width
shall display panel collapsed button to hide completely
shall allow maximizing panel to full width
shall show empty state when no cluster is active
shall remember last open tab view per window
